title: VocalT — Secure AI Voice-to-Text Telegram Bot
desc: Securely transcribes Burmese, English, and mixed-language Telegram audio with user-owned Gemini API keys.

details.problem: A multi-user transcription product needs to process multilingual Telegram audio without exposing, sharing, or centrally owning every user's Gemini credentials.
details.solution: VocalT provides a private, expiring BYOK setup flow, encrypts Gemini API keys with AES-256-GCM before Supabase storage, and decrypts them only on the server when a transcription request requires access.
details.outcome: A working MVP that operates as a real multi-user Telegram product across backend engineering, AI integration, database design, security, deployment, and product operations.
highlights: Burmese, English, and mixed-language voice transcription
Standard, timestamp, and speaker-separated transcript styles
Rate limiting, duplicate-update protection, and friendly failure handling
Privacy controls, complete data deletion, and a mobile-friendly admin dashboard
Automated TypeScript and Vitest checks with GitHub-to-Vercel deployment

title: Private School AI Enrollment Lead Qualification
image: assets/images/projects/Private School AI Enrollment Lead Qualification.png
desc: Helps private school admissions teams automatically qualify, prioritize, and manage incoming student enrollment inquiries.

details.problem: Private school admissions teams may need to manually review every enrollment inquiry, identify serious applicants, handle duplicate submissions, and decide which parents require faster follow-up. This creates repetitive administrative work and makes lead prioritization inconsistent and harder to manage.
details.solution: The system automates enrollment inquiry processing from form submission through validation, duplicate detection, AI qualification, lead scoring, storage, and staff notification. Deterministic safeguards and confidence-based review allow AI recommendations to support the admissions team without making final admission decisions.
highlights: HOT, WARM, and COLD enrollment lead qualification
Stable Lead ID and exact duplicate detection
Confidence-based manual review for uncertain results
Automatic HOT lead alerts with notification failure handling
Dedicated AI and workflow error handling

title: Publio
desc: Create once and publish across multiple social channels from one self-hosted dashboard.

details.problem: Creators and teams lose time rewriting and publishing the same content across disconnected social platforms.
details.solution: Publio brings writing, scheduling, and multi-channel publishing into one focused workspace that teams can host and control themselves.

title: Crash-Archi Workspace
desc: Turns raw ideas into structured, reviewable, development-ready project packages for AI-assisted building.

details.problem: Raw product ideas often reach development without enough problem definition, architecture, or implementation guidance.
details.solution: Crash-Archi creates a repeatable workspace for understanding the problem, defining architecture, planning the solution, and preparing AI-ready instructions.

title: Portfolio Website
desc: Connects projects, technical writing, learning resources, and services in one personal creator hub.

details.problem: Projects, writing, resources, and services are difficult to discover when they live across separate platforms.
details.solution: A fast, responsive personal hub presents the complete body of work through a consistent black-and-gold experience.

title: AI Lead Qualification Agent
desc: Researches and scores inbound leads, then alerts sales teams when a high-value opportunity appears.

details.problem: Sales teams spend valuable time manually researching and prioritizing every inbound lead.
details.solution: The workflow researches each company, evaluates ICP fit with AI, records the score, and immediately routes priority opportunities to Telegram.

title: AI Knowledge Support Agent
desc: Answers Telegram support questions with company knowledge, conversation memory, and web-search fallback.

details.problem: Support teams repeatedly answer the same questions while customers wait for information already available in company documents.
details.solution: The agent retrieves trusted company knowledge first, remembers the conversation, and uses web search only when internal context is insufficient.

title: AI Telegram Invoice Extractor
desc: Converts invoice photos and PDFs into structured records and returns an instant Telegram confirmation.

details.problem: Manually copying invoice fields into spreadsheets is slow, repetitive, and vulnerable to typing errors.
details.solution: Users send a photo or PDF in Telegram; AI OCR extracts the fields, saves a structured record, and sends a confirmation summary immediately.
